a.xlink:title: Asks the graphics side to build the card item for cardInfo and add it to this zone.
Marks the cached card items stale. Connected to every content-changing signal.
Called when a card is added to this zone. Default: reparents card to this item.
Builds the card item for cardInfo and hands it to this zone's logic.
The CardItems backing getLogic()->getCards(), in zone order.
